title: The Missing Logs
question: Could we observe privileged application actions on both customer-service systems during the review period?
briefing: There is no incident alert. Compare declared coverage with actual delivery. Use a harmless verification event, restore only the permitted future collection, and define what a successful observation window can and cannot establish.

facts.title: A collection question, not an incident alert
facts.text: Review privileged application visibility on CS-API and CS-PORTAL for steps -6 through 0. Authentication and application actions are different capabilities. No compromise alert initiated this hunt.

facts.title: Declared collection map
facts.text: The configuration dashboard declares privileged application-action collection active on CS-API and CS-PORTAL throughout steps -6 through 0. A declaration is not delivery evidence.

facts.title: Declared and observed collection disagree
facts.text: The delivery ledger shows CS-API heartbeats through step 0. CS-PORTAL last delivered at step -4; privileged application actions from -3 through 0 have no usable delivery coverage. This does not show whether activity occurred.

facts.title: A routing mismatch explains the pipeline gap
facts.text: The CS-PORTAL application collector points to a retired receiver. Detection Engineering owns the permitted future-only repair and repeat verification. This explains a collection failure, not the absence or intent of historical activity.

facts.title: Another source covers a different capability
facts.text: Identity logs retained privileged authentication at step -2. They cannot show the subsequent application action, its authorisation or its absence. They cannot fill the missing application interval.

queries.label: Inspect declared coverage
queries.can: Identify systems, capabilities and the promised historical interval.
queries.cannot: An enabled dashboard setting is not proof of event delivery.

queries.label: Compare delivered heartbeats
queries.can: Compare actual deliveries with the declared interval.
queries.cannot: A stopped pipeline does not establish an attacker or historical inactivity.

queries.label: Inspect collector routing
queries.can: Check whether the source points at the supported receiver.
queries.cannot: A configuration cause does not attribute activity in the blind interval.

queries.label: Examine the independent identity source
queries.cannot: Authentication cannot establish privileged application actions.

queries.label: Review the future observation window
queries.can: Report only the explicitly enabled source, target and future window.
queries.cannot: A successful controlled test does not reconstruct the historical gap.

events.description: An unauthorised privileged application action occurred in the uncollected historical interval.

truth.B: No unauthorised application action occurred. The pipeline misconfiguration was real.
truth.M: An unobserved unauthorised action occurred in the missing interval.
truth.U-B: No unauthorised application action occurred. The declared-but-missing collection was nevertheless a real operational defect.
truth.U-M: An unauthorised application action occurred inside the missing interval. Available authentication and controlled tests could not establish it.
